articles.title: Iran says Saudi Arabia, Houthis have not answered mediation offer
articles.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi stated there has been no response to Iran's mediation offer. This offer comes after intensified Houthi strikes against Saudi Arabia earlier this month. Egypt's involvement in the conflict could escalate tensions, but it has reassured Tehran of non-intervention. A vote in the Egyptian parliament regarding military action against the Houthis has been delayed until later in October.

articles.title: Gulf situation a matter of deep concern: EAM Jaishankar in talks with UAE peer
articles.description: S Jaishankar met with Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan to discuss the concerning situation in West Asia. They discussed potential US actions against Iran and the Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia. Jaishankar expressed India's commitment to promoting dialogue and diplomacy in the region. The two leaders highlighted the successful Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between India and the UAE.
